stemBlocks: Two loudspeakers are positioned $8.0 \text{ m}$ apart as shown. The loudspeakers emit sound waves of the same single frequency. The wave emitted by one loudspeaker is $180^{\circ}$ out of phase with the wave emitted by the other loudspeaker. A point P is in front of the loudspeakers. P is $18.0 \text{ m}$ from one loudspeaker and $24.0 \text{ m}$ from the other loudspeaker. As a result of superposition of the two waves arriving at P, the amplitude of the sound at position P is a minimum. The speed of the sound is $336 \text{ ms}^{-1}$.
What is the lowest possible frequency of the sound?
